title: 你反复想不明白的，不一定需要立刻得到答案
hook: 先把问题问清楚，答案才不会把你带偏。
body: 如果脑子一直回放同一个细节，先写下真正卡住你的点：TA的态度、关系走向，还是你自己的不安？
notes: Manual publishing only; no certainty claim

title: 反复回放的那句话，可能不是全部真相
hook: 一句话是线索，不是判决。
body: 关系里的信号要放回上下文里看：时间、语气、行动、修复和反复出现的模式。
notes: Manual publishing only; no mind-reading claim

title: 别让脑内复盘替你做决定
hook: 复盘是为了看清，不是为了惩罚自己。
body: 当你越想越乱，先停在一个小问题上：我现在最需要确认的是事实、感受，还是下一步？
cta: 得到一个更稳的下一步
notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure tactic

title: 越想越乱时，换一个更小的问题
hook: 不要问我们会不会有结果，先问下一步怎样更稳。
body: 大问题会把你推回焦虑，小问题会让你重新拿回一点行动感。
notes: Manual publishing only; no guaranteed outcome

title: 把你反复想不明白的那段关系，交给天机解读一次
hook: 不是替你决定，而是帮你把问题看清。
body: 当情绪一直绕圈，先让问题变得具体：关系模式、当前窗口、下一步和你真正想守住的东西。
notes: Manual publishing only; no perfect-accuracy claim

title: The question you cannot stop replaying
hook: Get clarity on the question you cannot stop replaying.
body: Scene 1: rereading one message. Scene 2: notes app with three possible meanings. Scene 3: ask a smaller question that can actually guide your next step.
notes: Manual publishing only; no outcome guarantee

title: One sentence is not the whole truth
hook: A sentence is a clue, not a verdict.
body: Use text overlays: context, timing, repair, pattern. End with one private CTA.
notes: Manual publishing only; no mind-reading claim

title: Stop letting replay make the decision
hook: Replaying is useful only if it helps you see clearly.
body: Show a looped phone screen, then a written question: what do I need to know before the next step?
notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure tactic

title: Make the question smaller
hook: Big questions create panic. Smaller questions create movement.
body: Prompt: instead of asking whether this is forever, ask what the next honest step is.
notes: Manual publishing only; no certainty claim

title: Clarity is not control
hook: Clarity will not control the outcome. It can steady your next step.
body: Quiet B-roll: tea, phone down, notebook. End with: private relationship reading, no public story needed.
notes: Manual publishing only; no perfect-accuracy claim

title: Replay-loop clarity
hook: Get clarity on the question you cannot stop replaying.
body: Not to control the outcome. To stop making your next step from panic.
notes: Manual publishing only

title: A clue, not a verdict
hook: One sentence from them is a clue, not the whole truth.
body: Put it back into context: timing, repair, actions, and the pattern that keeps repeating.
notes: Manual publishing only

title: Smaller question
hook: When the big question makes you spiral, make the question smaller.
body: What do I actually need to know before my next honest step?
notes: Manual publishing only

title: Replay is not proof
hook: The fact that you keep replaying it does not mean your worst interpretation is true.
body: It means your system wants clarity. Start there.
notes: Manual publishing only

title: Clarity over certainty
hook: Certainty is not always available. Clarity often is.
body: You may not know the ending today. You can still choose a steadier next step.
notes: Manual publishing only

title: Why do I keep replaying one relationship moment?
hook: Replaying often means the question is still too vague.
body: Try naming the exact question: are you trying to understand their intent, the relationship pattern, your next step, or your own fear? Once the question is smaller, the answer usually becomes less overwhelming. This is not about perfect certainty; it is about a steadier next move.
notes: Manual publishing only; disclose affiliation if posted

title: How do I stop overthinking their message?
hook: Do not treat one message as a verdict.
body: Put it into context: what happened before, what their actions show, whether repair happens, and whether this pattern repeats. Then ask one smaller question before you respond.
notes: Manual publishing only; no diagnosis framing

title: Should I ask them what they meant?
hook: Maybe, but first decide what you are actually asking for.
body: If you ask from panic, you may pressure the conversation. If you ask from clarity, you can keep it simple: this is what I noticed, this is what I need to understand, and this is the next step I can handle.
cta: Get a calmer next step: https://tianji.love/ask
notes: Manual publishing only; no guaranteed reply
